critical_code_review_comments: import_unified.py correctly uses content_hash (MD5) with legacy backfill so previous imports (without hash) are protected against re-insert — good idempotency design.

prettify_filename() is bypassed by --clean-names via `Meme #{before_total + i + 1}` — this couples the display name to the DB size AT COMMIT TIME. A future re-import into a partially populated DB will therefore not reproduce the exact same names (safe because content_hash prevents re-insert anyway, but worth noting for humans reading the code).

Category rotation uses `len(report.to_insert)` as index rather than folder index — deterministic and stable for the same input set, matches what was seen (510->Reactions, 511->Moods, 512->Clapbacks, 513->Relatable, i.e. positions 0..3 in BASE_CATEGORIES).
The --min-size-bytes=8192 guard correctly excluded the 3288-byte corrupt placeholder (verified no meme has source_filename ImgHunt_Threads_20260409_ImgHunt_Threads_20260409.jpeg).
generate_thumbnail is imported from /app/backend/server.py and produced thumbnails for all 4 new items (12-17KB each) — grid render sanity confirmed.
